# Files the supply-chain `secrets` job (trufflehog) does not scan. One anchored regex per line, matched against the
# repo-relative path of the changed file. Every entry is a test file that holds FAKE credentials on purpose, to prove
# the scrubbers redact them (fake password FAKEPW, host names that do not exist, no live account). See docs/ci/RELEASE-TRAIN.md
# ("Secret scan allowlist") before adding a line; tools/ci/test-trufflehog-allowlist.mjs keeps this file narrow.

^internal/applog/secretforms_test\.go$
^internal/evidence/secretforms_test\.go$
^internal/evidence/secretscrub_test\.go$
^internal/secretscrub/scrub_test\.go$
^internal/setup/secretforms_test\.go$
^tools/release/Test-ReleaseManager\.ps1$
